subject: mathematics
concept: Recognizing coins and simple money values, and counting small amounts
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies and sorts virtual coins by value
exercise.pictorial: Student counts a pictured small group of coins to find the total

misconception_flags: counts coins by quantity rather than by their value
